The '''Ancient Prison Approach''' was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] rift spanned by a bridge located in the [[Maximum Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The bridge connected MaxSec to the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] complex designated the [[Maximum Security thoroughfare]], which in turn led to the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]], but after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Belsavis|attack]] on the planet the Approach was occupied by the hostile [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
